verdict.rationale: The pack documents no Gitea feature for exporting a user's or instance's data (issues, PRs, wiki, settings) in open formats. Self-hosting under the MIT license on standard databases and a 342-path REST API are adjacent building blocks, not a documented export capability, so they earn no credit. The community post asking whether Gitea still lacks good backup and restore is only a question and creates no dispute.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
